verdict.rationale: Stripe's own docs show that invoices can be created, customized in content and branding, and sent as Stripe-hosted invoices, so the core invoicing part of the story is covered. Most of the specific compliance elements are not evidenced, and a community note says customer emails are off by default, so automatic delivery is unclear. Missing for 10: credit notes, receipts, sequential invoice numbering, custom fields, memos, evidence that delivery to customers is automatic, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform generates compliant invoices, credit notes, and receipts — sequential numbering, custom fields, memos — delivered to customers automatically

citations.quote: Create, customize, and send a Stripe-hosted invoice from the Dashboard, with no code required.
Customize invoices: Customize the content and branding of your invoices.
Create and manage subscriptions, track usage, and issue invoices.
